method: Execute the complete lesson sample with a fake Anthropic SDK under API-key-only and auth-token-only environments. Verify constructor arguments, custom base URL, lesson explanation and metadata source-bound checkpoint. No provider or network calls.

observations.trace: API key uses api_key; bearer auth token uses auth_token; both preserve configured base_url. The production page is centered with no horizontal overflow in either theme; only missing favicon.ico returns 404. The complete lesson verifier passed 16/16.

limitations: Fake SDK checks local parameter routing only; it does not verify real HTTP headers or compatible endpoint authentication.
Historical prompts, per-call usage, answer quality, billing, latency and the 4/4 missing-document summary remain unreproduced.
